intro: Our website, mobile applications and related software (the Application) are owned and operated by the Company incorporated under the laws of India.
These Terms form a binding legal agreement between the Company and you, the Applicant.
Please read these Terms before registering, accessing, browsing, downloading or using anything from the Application.
applicant_declaration: This application for a lending facility is made to a Lender who provides the facility with the assistance of the platform.
The platform collects, analyses and disseminates information and documents to Lenders to enable financial and other services.
You agree to submit, sign and execute all facility agreements and documents required by the Lender or the platform.
This declaration is made for the benefit and reliance of the Lender and the platform.
facility_grant: Grant of the Facility is at the sole discretion of the Lender or platform and subject to execution of required documents.
The Lender or platform may reject your application without assigning any reason, and you cannot appeal or contest that decision.
Any processing fee paid in relation to the application is non-refundable, including where the application is rejected.
Information and documents submitted may be retained and may not be returned to you.
accuracy: You declare that you are a citizen of or resident in India.
All particulars, information and documents provided are true, correct, accurate and up to date.
You have not withheld or suppressed any material information.
You will inform the Lender or platform of changes in occupation, employment, residency, control, capital structure or management.
disclosure_consent: You consent to disclosure by the Lender or platform of information relating to you, your directors and group companies or partners.
You waive the right of notice, privacy and privity for such disclosure as permitted under applicable law.
Any default or non-performance may be disclosed to the RBI, credit information companies and other authorised agencies.
Information may be disclosed to actual or potential assignees, transferees or participants in the Lender's rights and obligations.
The Lender or platform may seek information about you from regulatory authorities and third parties on a continuing basis.
co_lending_consent: You consent to the platform sharing your data with co-lending partners for collection, storage, analysis and dissemination.
Data may be used for verification, authentication and to assess eligibility for loans and value-added services.
You may be contacted by authorised members, agents or lending partners by email, telephone or text message.
You agree to receive promotional materials and special offers and to provide KYC documents required by the RBI.
This declaration and application may be routed to multiple Lenders at the discretion of the platform.
Funds availed will be used only for the sanctioned purpose and not for any speculative, illegal or anti-social purpose.
uidai: You voluntarily consent to the platform or Lender using your Aadhaar number, name and biometrics to authenticate you with UIDAI.
Aadhaar details will be used only for demographic authentication, validation, e-KYC and OTP authentication.
A record of the search may be retained as per applicable laws for KYC verification or Aadhaar-based authentication.
Your biometric details will not be stored or shared and will be submitted to CIDR only for authentication.
You confirm the Aadhaar details submitted are accurate, current and complete and will not hold the platform liable for incorrect information provided by you.
You consent to Aadhaar-based authentication for e-sign generation, e-mandate registration and validating your consent to the agreements.
acceptance: By accepting this declaration you are deemed to have read, understood and agreed to be bound by these Terms.
You represent that the declarations are made in your true and lawful capacity.
The Lender and platform will rely on the correctness and accuracy of your declarations.
Any inaccuracy or falsehood gives the Lender or platform the right to cancel the Facility and exercise all available rights under applicable law.

general: This policy applies to payments made through Finora using supported digital payment methods such as cards, bank accounts, wallets and UPI.
The availability of specific payment methods may vary depending on the service and payment provider.
failed: If an amount is debited but the transaction shows as failed, the payment may be automatically reversed by the payment provider.
Reversal time may depend on your bank, card issuer or payment gateway.
If the amount is not reversed within the expected period, contact Finora Support with the transaction details.
duplicate: If the same payment is processed more than once, Finora may verify the duplicate transaction.
The excess amount may be refunded to the original method, adjusted against a future payment, or handled per service-specific terms.
The method and timing may depend on the payment provider and the nature of the transaction.
requests: If you believe you are entitled to a refund, contact Finora Support using the details in the application.
You may be asked for the transaction ID, date and time, amount, payment method and payment confirmation.
Finora may review the transaction before approving a refund.
processing: Approved refunds are generally initiated through the original payment method where technically possible.
The time to appear in your account depends on your bank, payment gateway, network and payment method.
Finora is not responsible for delays caused by a bank, processor, network or third-party provider after the refund is initiated.
cancellation: Where a service allows cancellation, you may request it through the app or by contacting Finora Support.
Cancellation eligibility may vary depending on the service and the stage of the request.
Some transactions may not be cancellable once processing has started or the service is complete.
non_refundable: Certain fees or services may be non-refundable where clearly communicated before the transaction is completed.
Non-refundable payments will generally not be refunded except where required by law or where Finora determines an exception is appropriate.
payment_failures: Finora may not be responsible for payment failures outside its reasonable control.
This includes incorrect payment information, insufficient funds or transaction limits.
This includes bank or provider restrictions, expired or blocked instruments and gateway or network failures.
This includes connectivity problems, bank holidays, maintenance and fraud-prevention measures.
Where a payment fails, Finora may communicate the transaction status through the app or other channels.
provider_processing: Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers with their own terms and timelines.
Finora may rely on transaction information from the payment provider to determine payment status.
verification: Finora may perform reasonable checks before processing a refund, including verifying the transaction and payment status.
Checks may include the associated account, the reason for the request and whether the amount was already refunded.
False or fraudulent refund information may result in rejection and restrictions on account access.
changes_payment: Finora may add, remove, suspend or modify supported payment methods or providers from time to time.
Changes may be made for operational, security, technical, legal or business reasons.
policy_updates: We may update this policy from time to time.
The updated version will be published through the app or website and the Last Updated date will be revised.
We recommend reviewing this policy periodically.
contact: For questions about a payment, cancellation, refund or transaction status, contact Finora Support through the app.

why_important: Keeping your contact information up to date helps ensure you receive important communications.
It helps you maintain secure access to your account and stay informed about relevant services and opportunities.
communication: Finora may use your registered mobile number and email to reach you when necessary.
This includes transaction alerts, payment reminders, account updates and service notifications.
security: Your registered contact information may be used to authenticate your account and provide secure digital services.
Depending on available services, you may view account information, access statements, perform eligible transactions and raise service requests online.
opportunities: Keeping your contact information updated helps ensure you do not miss relevant information about services, features, benefits or offers.
Finora may communicate service updates, promotional offers or other opportunities through your registered contact details, subject to your preferences.
reach_us: You can contact Finora through the support channels provided in the app or website.
Phone and email support options are available within the application.
request_update: You can request an update or change to your registered contact information by contacting Finora Support.
For security, Finora may require you to verify your identity before making any changes.
self_service: If self-service account management is available, you may update your mobile number or email in your account settings.
Log in with your registered credentials and go to Profile, Account Settings or Contact Information to review or update your details.
If self-service changes are not available, contact Finora Support for assistance.

nach_cancellation.title: NACH Cancellation Request
nach_cancellation.menu_subtitle: Request cancellation of your NACH mandate
nach_cancellation.description: Submit a request to cancel your active NACH mandate linked to your account.
information: You can request cancellation of an active NACH mandate associated with your account.
The cancellation request may require verification of your identity and account details.
Your request will be reviewed and processed subject to applicable banking and payment network procedures.
Until the cancellation is confirmed, the existing mandate may remain active.
Cancellation of a NACH mandate does not automatically cancel any outstanding payment, repayment or other financial obligation.

ndc_certificate.title: NDC Certificate Request
ndc_certificate.description: Submit a request for a No Due Certificate confirming that there are no outstanding dues associated with an eligible account or facility.
information: You can request a No Due Certificate after your eligible financial obligations have been fully settled.
The certificate is issued only after Finora verifies the account status and confirms that there are no outstanding dues.
Any pending amount, unresolved transaction, fee, charge or other obligation may affect your eligibility for the certificate.
The request may require verification of your identity and account details.
The availability and processing time of the certificate may vary depending on the account and verification process.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
items: The relevant account or financial facility should have no outstanding dues.
All applicable payments should be successfully received and reflected in the account.
There should be no pending payment, adjustment, dispute or other unresolved obligation.
Additional verification may be required before the certificate is issued.
